name: 7109-fixedlen-opt125m-2gpu
hardware: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:2), sm90, NVLink between the two cards.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one node, `--distributed-executor-backend ray`, with the SPMD-worker + Ray-compiled-DAG control plane enabled in configs/tuned.yaml. One in-process engine whose two tensor-parallel workers are Ray actors, not a cluster.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, static seed 6888. 256 streams matches `max-num-seqs`, so the queue stays full for the whole scored window.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, `request_format: plain` (opt-125m ships no chat template). Prompt exactly 100 tokens and output exactly 100 (min = max), greedy (temperature 0.0), `ignore_eos` on, so every request is the same fixed amount of work.
purpose: A compact autocomplete assistant serving 256 concurrent users fixed 100-token prompts and replies across two linked GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.4-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM (no chunked prefill, no max_seq_len_to_capture).
model: facebook/opt-125m
tensor-parallel-size: 2

# LOAD-BEARING: the SPMD control plane exists only on the Ray executor. Under `mp` the two
# environment variables in configs/tuned.yaml are inert and this is not the declared setup.
distributed-executor-backend: ray

dtype: float16
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
num-scheduler-steps: 1
